title: Bài thi thử nói lớp 7
note: Bài thi thử một lần, KHÁC dạng bài kiểm tra nghiên cứu: không tiếng bíp, không giới hạn thời gian, học sinh tự bấm khi sẵn sàng. Nhóm soạn theo Unit 1–3, chưa thầy cô duyệt. Không trùng đề A/B (test tự động kiểm tra).

questions.text: Tell me about a hobby you enjoy in your free time.
How often do you do exercise?
What do you usually eat for breakfast?
Have you ever done any volunteer work?
Why do you enjoy your hobby?
Do you think teenagers should eat more vegetables? Why?
What is the best way to stay healthy? Why?
Which community activity would you like to join? Why?
Your friend often stays up late playing games. What advice can you give him?
Your class wants to help an old people's home. Suggest one activity.
